statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-116332 (PostgreSQL portal setup use-after-free executes arbitrary code) is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 16.16 for major version 16. The PostgreSQL security page, https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116332/, lists 16.16 as the fixed release for 16, and the 16.16 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/16.16/, list this CVE. The fix on the REL_16_STABLE branch is commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/38783780f6d9cf969320e6f6b4b63050df2a378a, which carries the trailer "Security: CVE-2026-116332", is contained in the REL_16_16 tag and not in REL_16_15, and changes src/backend/utils/mmgr/portalmem.c so that PortalDrop() refuses to drop a portal that is still being set up, CLOSE ALL skips such portals, and transaction and subtransaction abort mark them failed so that error cleanup releases them; its other changes are regression tests. Alpine's postgresql16 16.16-r0 on the 3.23-stable branch upgrades to the upstream 16.16 release and lists CVE-2026-116332 under 16.16-r0 in its secfixes: https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/859fa0795e895af033fab32094a83301f2b4d8ff/community/postgresql16/APKBUILD. None of the Alpine patches applied in that APKBUILD change the C source files the fix touches. The DHI postgresql16 16.16-r0 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from that APKBUILD and the upstream PostgreSQL 16.16 source tarball. The DHI Alpine 3.23 package repository (x86_64 and aarch64) publishes packages built from source postgresql16 at 16.13-r0, 16.14-r0, 16.15-r0 and 16.16-r0. The vulnerable code is in the server, usr/libexec/postgresql16/postgres, which the postgresql16 package ships in every published build on both architectures. In the 16.16-r0 build the postgres server binary reports PostgreSQL 16.16 on both x86_64 and aarch64, and in each earlier build (16.13-r0, 16.14-r0 and 16.15-r0) it reports that older 16.x release on both architectures. The error message the fix adds, "cannot drop portal \"%s\" while it is being set up", is present in the postgres binary in the 16.16-r0 build and absent from it in every earlier build, on both architectures, while the existing "cannot drop active portal" message is present in every build. The earlier builds are upstream releases before 16.16, so they are affected; 16.16-r0 and later carry the fix.

PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-116332 (PostgreSQL portal setup use-after-free executes arbitrary code) in 18.7 for major version 18: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116332/ lists 18.7 as the fixed release for 18, and the 18.7 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/18.7/, list this CVE. The fix is commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/8a2982de9f1a6f859d740b52cb97b457a29d009e on the REL_18_STABLE branch, tagged Security: CVE-2026-116332 and Backpatch-through: 14, in the REL_18_7 release tag and not in REL_18_6. It changes src/backend/utils/mmgr/portalmem.c so that PortalDrop() refuses to drop a portal that is still being set up (status PORTAL_NEW or PORTAL_DEFINED), CLOSE ALL skips such portals, and transaction and subtransaction abort mark them failed so that they can be cleaned up; it also adds two injection points to src/backend/tcop/postgres.c for its tests, and its other changes are tests. The DHI postgresql18 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from Alpine's postgresql18 APKBUILD, https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/59a1f1d230675807d5a95a0c1e57ba5d640ba039/main/postgresql18/APKBUILD, which builds the upstream PostgreSQL release tarball; none of the patches it applies touch the files this fix changes, and it lists CVE-2026-116332 under its 18.7-r0 secfixes. The DHI Alpine 3.23 package repository (x86_64 and aarch64) publishes packages built from source postgresql18 at 18.1-r0, 18.2-r0, 18.3-r0, 18.4-r0, 18.6-r0 and 18.7-r0. The vulnerable code is in the postgres server binary, /usr/libexec/postgresql18/postgres, which the postgresql18 package ships in every one of those builds on both architectures. We checked the postgres server binary in every published postgresql18 package for Alpine 3.23 on both x86_64 and aarch64 (checksums verified against the package index): 18.7-r0 reports PostgreSQL 18.7, while the earlier builds 18.1-r0, 18.2-r0, 18.3-r0, 18.4-r0 and 18.6-r0 report 18.1, 18.2, 18.3, 18.4 and 18.6. The error message the fix adds, cannot drop portal "%s" while it is being set up, appears in the 18.7-r0 server binary and in no earlier build, while the existing message cannot drop active portal "%s" appears in every build. The earlier builds are upstream releases before 18.7, so they are affected; 18.7-r0 is the first published build that carries the fix.

PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-116332, a use after free in portal setup that lets an object creator execute arbitrary code by closing the portal being prepared from user-defined code run during planning or executor startup, in 17.12 (https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-116332/, https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-116332, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/17.12/). Earlier 17 releases are affected. The server binary in this owner's 17.12-0 build and in its rebuild of Debian's 17.12-0+deb13u1 reports PostgreSQL 17.12 on amd64 and arm64, so both carry the fix. The 17.11-1 build and the current rebuild of Debian's 17.11-0+deb13u1 report PostgreSQL 17.11, and the earlier rebuilds of Debian's 17.10-0+deb13u1 and 17.11-0+deb13u1, no longer in the repository, package PostgreSQL 17.10 and 17.11. All of these are affected and sort below 17.12-0.
